script: Red dwarfs are the most common stars in our galaxy. They are smaller and cooler than the Sun. Almost none of them are bright enough to see without a telescope. They burn their fuel so slowly that they can shine for trillions of years. Not one red dwarf has died yet, because the universe is not old enough.
